policy: APPENDED source records: the frozen golden_cases.json is unchanged; these cases run beside it and are preserved likewise.

source_manifest.notes: Kalshi's own rulebooks (series contract_terms_url: BASKETBALLGAMEWIN, FOOTBALLGAMEWIN, BASEBALLGAMEWIN, HOCKEYWINNINGINPERIOD) recorded byte for byte with sha256, plus the market rule text of six live game markets. Production 088af82 refused every Kalshi game alias UNKNOWN_STATES because the market text alone never states overtime or the tie payout.

cases.statement: An entire-game KXMLBGAME market with the live-verified BASEBALLGAMEWIN rulebook: extra innings included, a tie without a Tie strike pays $0.50; every result state is priced, so the aliases fingerprint; away YES and home NO differ only where each market settles at its own fair price.
HOCKEYWINNINGINPERIOD includes overtime and the shootout but says a drawn team 'may resolve to No': not a fixed payout, so the tie state stays unknown and the alias is refused.
A rulebook whose live hash differs from the recorded bytes applies nothing: RULEBOOK_CHANGED_SINCE_RECORDING, the alias stays UNKNOWN_STATES.
